summary: Regulates submarine warfare and shipbuilding.

name: Convention Between the United States and Great Britain (1930)
summary: Definitely delimits the boundary between North Borneo (then a British protectorate ) and the Philippine archipelago (then a U.S. Territory ).

name: Treaty of Westminster (1931)
note: Also known as the Statute of Westminster 1931 .
summary: Creates the British Commonwealth .

name: Soviet–Polish Non-Aggression Pact
summary: International treaty of non-aggression signed by representatives of Poland and the USSR.

name: German–Polish declaration of non-aggression
summary: International treaty between Nazi Germany and the Second Polish Republic ; both countries pledged to settle disputes through bilateral negotiations.

name: Balkan Pact
summary: Between Greece, Turkey, Romania, and Yugoslavia; signatories agree to suspend all disputed territorial claims against each other.

name: Franco-Soviet Treaty of Mutual Assistance
summary: Bilateral pact between France and the USSR with the aim of containing German aggression.

name: Treaty of Establishment, Commerce and Navigation
note: Also known as the Treaty of Establishment, Commerce and Navigation with Full Protocols and Annex .
summary: Reinforces the Russo-Persian Treaty of Friendship .

name: Anglo-Egyptian Treaty of 1936
summary: The United Kingdom withdraws its troops from Egypt except those necessary to protect the Suez Canal and its surroundings.

name: Franco-Syrian Treaty of Independence (1936)
summary: France provides independence to Syria.

name: Montreux Convention Regarding the Regime of the Straits
summary: Approve Turkish control on Bosphorus and Dardanelles Straits

name: International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling
summary: Establishes limitations on whaling practices; protocols signed in 1938 and again in 1945.

name: Treaty of Saadabad
note: Also known as the Saadabad Pact .
summary: A non-aggression pact signed by Turkey, Iran, Iraq and Afghanistan.

name: Munich Agreement
summary: Surrenders the Sudetenland to Germany.

name: Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact
note: Also known as the Hitler–Stalin Pact , the German–Soviet Nonaggression Pact , the or Nazi–Soviet Pact and formally as the Treaty of Nonaggression between Germany and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics .
summary: Soviet-German non-aggression pact.

name: Pact of Steel
summary: Pact of Friendship and Alliance between Germany and Italy.

name: Moscow Peace Treaty
summary: Ends the Winter War .

name: Treaty of Commerce and Navigation
summary: Reinforces the Treaty of Establishment, Commerce and Navigation between Iran and the Soviet Union.

name: Tripartite Pact
summary: Axis Powers of Second World War are formed

name: Treaty of Craiova
summary: Romania cedes territories to Bulgaria.

name: Tokyo Convention
summary: Ends the Franco-Thai War .

name: Anglo-Soviet Treaty of 1942
summary: Twenty-year mutual assistance agreement between the United Kingdom and the USSR that establishes both a military and political alliance.

name: Bretton Woods Agreement
summary: Establishes rules for commercial and financial relations among the major industrial states.

name: Tito–Šubašić Agreement
note: Also known as the Treaty of Vis .
summary: Attempts to merge Yugoslavian governments.

name: Chicago Convention on International Civil Aviation
summary: Establishes the International Civil Aviation Organization ; ratified in 1947.

name: London Protocol (1944)
summary: Prepares for the division of Germany into three occupation zones.

name: Treaty of Varkiza
note: Also known as the Varkiza Pact and the Varkiza Peace Agreement .
summary: Attempts to officially end the Greek Civil War .

name: United Nations Charter
summary: Establishes the United Nations .

name: Wanfried Agreement
summary: Transfers three Hessian villages to the Soviet Union and two Eichsfeld villages to the United States.

name: Bermuda Agreement
summary: Bilateral agreement on civil aviation between the United States and United Kingdom.

name: Keflavik Agreement
summary: Between the US and Iceland

name: Gruber–De Gasperi Agreement
summary: South Tyrol and Trentino remain part of Italy, but ensures their autonomy as region of Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol .

name: International Convention for the Regulation of Whaling
summary: Replaces the International Agreement for the Regulation of Whaling; governs the commercial, scientific, and aboriginal subsistence whaling practices of fifty-nine member nations.

name: 1946 Lake Success Protocol
note: Also known formally as the Protocol Amending the Agreements, Conventions and Protocols on Narcotic Drugs concluded at The Hague on 23 January 1912, at Geneva on 11 February 1925 and 19 February 1925, and 13 July 1931, at Bangkok on 27 November 1931 and at Geneva on 26 June 1936 .
summary: Shifts drug control functions previously assigned to the League of Nations to the United Nations .

name: Treaty of Manila (1946)
note: Also known as the Treaty of General Relations Between The United States Of America And The Republic Of The Philippines (archived from the original on 2009-03-26).
summary: The United States recognizes the independence of the Republic of the Philippines.

name: Treaty of London (1946)
summary: Great Britain recognizes the independence of Transjordan .

name: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as GATT .
summary: Establishes international trade rules.

name: Paris Peace Treaties, 1947
summary: Formally ends World War II in the European Theatre .

name: Inter-American Treaty of Reciprocal Assistance
note: Also known as the Rio Treaty and Rio Pact .
summary: A "hemispheric defense" doctrine signed by many nations in the Americas.

name: United Nations Education, Scientific and Cultural Organization
summary: Establishes the department of the United Nations that deals with Education, Science, and Culture.

name: North Atlantic Treaty
note: Also known as the Treaty of Washington .
summary: Establishes NATO , the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.

name: Fourth Geneva Convention
note: Also known as GCIV .
summary: Establishes rules for the protection of civilians during wartime.

name: Treaty of The Hague (1949)
summary: The Netherlands grants independence to Indonesia except for the South Molucca Islands and West Irian .

name: Treaty of London (1949)
summary: Creates the Council of Europe .

name: Liaquat–Nehru Pact
summary: Between Pakistani Prime Minister Liaquat Ali Khan and Indian Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru , India.

name: Treaty of Zgorzelec
note: Also known formally as the Treaty between the Republic of Poland and the German Democratic Republic concerning the demarcation of the established and existing Polish-German state border .
summary: Establishes borders between the Republic of Poland and the German Democratic Republic .

name: Mutual Defense Treaty (U.S.–Philippines)
summary: A mutual defense accord between the Philippines and the United States.

name: Genocide Convention
summary: Defines and outlaws genocide .

name: Treaty of San Francisco
note: Also known as San Francisco Peace Treaty and the Treaty of Peace with Japan .
summary: Formally ends the war between the Allies of World War II and Japan.

name: Security Treaty Between the United States and Japan
summary: A mutual defense agreement between the United States and Japan; went into effect on April 28, 1952.

name: U.S. and Japan Mutual Defense Assistance Agreement
summary: Permits U.S. armed forces to station troops in Japan while encouraging Japan to rearm for defensive purposes only; went into effect on May 1, 1954.

name: ANZUS Treaty
note: Also known as the Australia, New Zealand, United States Security Treaty .
summary: Alliance between Australia, New Zealand and the United States.

name: Treaty of Taipei
note: Also known as the Sino-Japanese Peace Treaty .
summary: Peace treaty between Japan and the Republic of China .

name: General Treaty
note: Also known as the Deutschlandvertrag .
summary: Treaty between the Federal Republic of Germany and the Western Allies (France, UK, USA) restoring (limited) German sovereignty.

name: International Convention relating to Arrest of Sea-going Ships
summary: Standardises rules relating to arrest of ships in port.

name: Korean War Armistice Agreement
note: s:Korean Armistice Agreement
summary: Ended the fighting between the United Nations Command and the Korean People's Army & PRC People's Liberation Army .

name: Central Treaty Organization
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as CENTO ; original name was the Middle East Treaty Organization or METO ; also known as the Baghdad Pact .
summary: Alliance of Middle Eastern countries and the United Kingdom.

name: Southeast Asia Collective Defense Treaty
note: Also known as the Manila Pact .
summary: Established the Southeast Asia Treaty Organization , (SEATO), a defensive alliance between Australia, France, New Zealand, Pakistan, Philippines, South Korea, South Vietnam, Thailand, the United Kingdom and the United States.

name: Asian–African Conference
note: Also known as the Bandung Conference .
summary: Conference stated to promote Afro-Asian economic and cultural cooperation and to oppose colonialism or neocolonialism by the United States, the Soviet Union, or any other "imperialistic" nation.

name: Austrian State Treaty
note: Also known as the Austrian Independence Treaty .
summary: Re-establishes a free, sovereign and democratic Austria.

name: Simonstown Agreement
summary: The Royal Navy surrenders its naval base at Simonstown , South Africa and transfers command of the South African Navy to the government of South Africa.

name: Warsaw Pact
note: Also known as the Warsaw Treaty and the Treaty of Friendship, Co-operation and Mutual Assistance .
summary: Alliance of Central and Eastern European communist states.

name: Soviet–Japanese Joint Declaration of 1956
summary: Reestablishes diplomatic relations between the Soviet Union and Japan following World War II.

name: Anglo-Malayan Defence Agreement
note: Also known as the Anglo-Malaysian Defence Agreement .
summary: Provides a security umbrella for the independent Malaya .

name: Treaty of Rome
note: Also known as the Treaty establishing the European Economic Community .
summary: Establishes the European Economic Community .

name: International Atomic Energy Treaty
summary: Establishes the International Atomic Energy Agency .

name: 1958 US–UK Mutual Defence Agreement
summary: Bilateral treaty between the United States and the United Kingdom on nuclear weapons cooperation.

name: Lisbon Agreement for the Protection of Appellations of Origin and their International Registration
summary: Protection of Appellations of Origin and establishment of an International Register of Appellations of Origin, run by the World Intellectual Property Organization .

name: Convention on the Territorial Sea and the Contiguous Zone
summary: Provides new universal legal controls for the management of marine natural resources and the control of pollution.

name: Antarctic Treaty System
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as ATS .
summary: Sets aside Antarctica as a scientific preserve, establishes freedom of scientific investigation and bans military activity on the continent; came into force in 1961.

name: Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security between the United States and Japan
summary: Strengthens Japan's ties to the "West" during the Cold War era.

name: The Indus Waters Treaty 1960
summary: Water sharing treaty between India and Pakistan.

name: 1960 Treaty of Montevideo
summary: Establishes the Latin American Free Trade Association .

name: London and Zurich Agreements
summary: Between United Kingdom, Turkey and Greece about the independence and Guarantee of Cyprus .

name: Arms Control and Disarmament Agency
summary: Strengthens U.S. national security by implementing effective policies of arms control and disarmament.

name: Apostille Convention
summary: International treaty drafted by the Hague Conference on Private International Law. It specifies the modalities through which a document issued in one of the signatory countries can be certified for legal purposes in all the other signatory states. Such a certification is called an apostille (French: certification). The apostille is an international certification. The treaty is also officially known as the Hague Convention Abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents.

name: Columbia River Treaty
summary: International agreement between Canada and the United States on the development and operation of the upper Columbia River basin.

name: Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations
summary: International treaty on diplomatic intercourse and the privileges and immunities of diplomatic missions; came into force in 1964.

name: Alliance for Progress
summary: U.S. President Dwight D. Eisenhower attempts to establish economic cooperation between North America and South America.

name: Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs
summary: International treaty regulating the manufacture and use for medical purposes, and banning the trafficking of narcotic drugs.

name: Convention on the Reduction of Statelessness
summary: International treaty against statelessness; went into effect on December 13, 1975.

name: Rome Convention for the Protection of Performers, Producers of Phonograms and Broadcasting Organisations
summary: Adopted on October 26, 1961. The Rome Convention secures protection in performances for performers, in phonograms for producers of phonograms and in broadcasts for broadcasting organizations.

name: Nassau Agreement
summary: The United States provides the United Kingdom with nuclear-armed Polaris missiles in return for a nuclear submarine base in the Holy Loch , near Glasgow .

name: New York Agreement
summary: Agreement between the Republic of Indonesia and the Kingdom of the Netherlands Concerning West New Guinea (West Irian). Transferred responsibility for a territory to the United Nations and arranged for subsequent administration by Indonesia pending an act of self-determination defined in agreement.

name: Sino–North Korean Border Treaty
summary: Border treaty made in secret between the People's Republic of China and North Korea that, in combination with a subsequent 1963 treaty, defines the modern border between the two countries.

name: Vienna Convention on Consular Relations
summary: Multilateral treaty that codifies consular practices.

name: Vienna Convention on Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage
summary: Sets rules of liability for any and all forms of nuclear damage.

name: Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty
note: Also known as the Limited Test Ban Treaty , the Nuclear Test Ban Treaty and the Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests In The Atmosphere, In Outer Space And Under Water .
summary: Prohibiting all test detonations of nuclear weapons except underground.

name: Élysée Treaty
note: Also known as the Franco-German Partnership .
summary: Franco-German agreement for joint cooperation in foreign policy, economic and military integration, and exchange of student education.

name: Strasbourg Convention
note: Also known as the Strasbourg Patent Convention and the Convention on the Unification of Certain Points of Substantive Law on Patents for Invention .
summary: Harmonizes patent laws across European countries.

name: Merger Treaty
summary: Organizes the European Coal and Steel Community , the European Economic Community and Euratom ; creates European Commission and the Council of the European Communities ; came into force on July 1, 1967.

name: Treaty on Basic Relations between Japan and the Republic of Korea
summary: Established basic relationship between Japan and the Republic of Korea (South Korea).

name: Treaty of Tlatelolco
note: Also known as the Treaty for the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons in Latin America and the Caribbean .
summary: Keeps Latin American and the Caribbean regions free of nuclear weapons.

name: ASEAN Declaration
note: Also known as the Bangkok Declaration .
summary: Founding document of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations .

name: WIPO Convention
note: Also known as the Convention Establishing the World Intellectual Property Organization .
summary: Established the World Intellectual Property Organization .

name: Outer Space Treaty
note: Also known as the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space, including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies .
summary: Forbids the placing of nuclear weapons or any other weapons of mass destruction on celestial bodies and into outer space in general.

name: Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons
note: Also known as the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons .
summary: Limits the spread of nuclear weapons through non-proliferation, disarmament, and the right to utilize nuclear technology for peaceful purposes.

name: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Racial Discrimination
summary: Commits signatories to the elimination of racial discrimination and the promotion of understanding among all races.

name: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as the VCLT .
summary: Codifies the pre-existing international customary law on treaties with some necessary gap-filling and clarifications.

name: Arusha Agreement
summary: Establishes better economic relations between the European Community and the nations of Kenya , Uganda , and Tanzania ; came into force in 1971.

name: Hague Hijacking Convention
summary: Criminalises the hijacking of civil aviation aircraft.

name: Patent Cooperation Treaty
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as the PCT .
summary: Provides a unified procedure for filing patent applications to protect inventions internationally; came into force in 1978; amended in 1979; modified in 1984 and 2001.

name: Boundary Treaty of 1970
summary: Settles boundary disputes between the United States and Mexico.

name: Treaty of Warsaw (1970)
summary: West Germany and the People's Republic of Poland pledge themselves to nonviolence and accept the Oder–Neisse line ; ratified in 1972.

name: Convention on Psychotropic Substances
summary: Attempts to control psychoactive drugs such as amphetamines , barbiturates , and LSD .

name: Five Power Defence Arrangements
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as the FPDA .
summary: Security agreement between Australia, Malaysia , New Zealand, Singapore and the United Kingdom.

name: Ramsar Convention
summary: Focuses on the conservation and sustainable utilization of wetlands ; went into effect in 1975.

name: IPC Agreement
note: Also known as the Strasbourg Agreement Concerning the International Patent Classification .
summary: Establishes a common classification for patents for invention, inventors' certificates, utility models and utility certificates; went into effect in 1975; amended in 1979.

name: Seabed Arms Control Treaty
note: Also known as the Seabed Treaty .
summary: Bans the placement of nuclear weapons on the ocean floor beyond a 12-mile (19 km) coastal zone; came into force in 1972.

name: Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation
summary: Criminalises sabotage of civil aircraft and dangerous acts on board aircraft

name: Indo-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Cooperation
summary: Specifies strategic cooperation between India and the Soviet Union.

name: Geneva Phonograms Convention
summary: Convention for the Protection of Producers of Phonograms Against Unauthorized Duplication of Their Phonograms; adopted in Geneva in October 1971.

name: Strasbourg Agreement Concerning the International Patent Classification
summary: Adopted: Strasbourg - March 24, 1971. Amended: September 28, 1979.

name: Addis Ababa Agreement (1972)
summary: A series of accords between the government of Sudan and insurgents in Southern Sudan, which ended the First Sudanese Civil War

name: Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty
note: Also known as the ABM Treaty or ABMT .
summary: Limits the use of anti-ballistic missile (ABM) systems in defending areas against missile-delivered nuclear weapons (US PL 92-448).

name: Basic Treaty (1972)
note: Also known as the Treaty concerning the basis of relations between the Federal Republic of Germany and the German Democratic Republic .
summary: Establishes relations between the Federal Republic of Germany and the German Democratic Republic ; came into effect in 1973.

name: Biological Weapons Convention
note: Also known as the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production and Stockpiling of Bacteriological (Biological) and Toxin Weapons and on their Destruction .
summary: First multilateral disarmament treaty banning the production of an entire category of biological weapons (with exceptions for medical and defensive purposes in small quantities).

name: Convention for the Conservation of Antarctic Seals
summary: Provides protection for Antarctic seals ; came into effect in 1978.

name: London Convention on the Prevention of Marine Pollution by Dumping of Wastes and Other Matter
summary: Attempts to control pollution of the sea via deliberate dumping by vessels, aircraft, and platforms.

name: Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué
note: Also known formally as the Joint Communiqué of the Government of Japan and the Government of the People's Republic of China .
summary: Japan recognizes PRC as the sole legal Government of China; and China renounces its demand for war reparation from Japan

name: Simla Agreement
note: Also known as the Simla Pact and the Simla Treaty .
summary: Normalised relations between India and Pakistan following the Bangladesh Liberation War .

name: European Patent Convention
note: Also known as the Convention on the Grant of European Patents .
summary: Multilateral treaty instituting the European Patent Organisation .

name: Agreement on the Transfer of Corpses
summary: Establishes rules and standards for the transfer of human corpses across international borders

name: CITES - The Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora
summary: Also known as the Washington Convention; Regulates international trade of endangered species of animals and plants (live specimens, as well as their parts and derivatives)

name: Treaty of Chaguaramas
summary: Establishes the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) signed by Barbados , Trinidad and Tobago , Guyana , and Jamaica and replaces the previous Caribbean Free Trade Association in 1974.

name: Paris Peace Accords
summary: Formalized American withdrawal from Vietnam .

name: Vientiane Treaty
summary: A cease-fire agreement between the monarchial government of Laos and the communist Pathet Lao .

name: Agreement on the Transfer of Corpses
summary: Establishes rules and standards for the transport of human corpses across international borders. Intended to replace a similar 1937 treaty.

name: Sunningdale Agreement
summary: Established a power-sharing Northern Ireland Executive under Brian Faulkner of the UUP and Gerry Fitt of the SDLP .

name: Japan–Australia Migratory Bird Agreement
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as JAMBA .
summary: Treaty between Australia and Japan to minimise harm to the major areas used by birds that migrate between the two countries; came into force in 1981.

name: Threshold Test Ban Treaty
note: Also known as the Treaty on the Limitation of Underground Nuclear Weapon Tests .
summary: Establishes a nuclear "threshold" by prohibiting nuclear tests of devices having a yield exceeding 150 kilotons .

name: Brussels Convention Relating to the Distribution of Programme-Carrying Signals Transmitted by Satellite
summary: The Brussels or Satellites Convention provides for the obligation of each Contracting State to take adequate measures to prevent the unauthorized distribution on or from its territory of any programme-carrying signal transmitted by satellite.

name: Treaty of Osimo
summary: Divides the Free Territory of Trieste between Italy and Yugoslavia.

name: Treaty of Lagos
summary: Establishes the Economic Community of West African States .

name: Environmental Modification Convention
note: Also known as the Convention on the Prohibition of Military or Any Other Hostile Use of Environmental Modification Techniques .
summary: Prohibits the military or other hostile use of environmental modification techniques; came into force in 1978.

name: Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia
summary: Treaty signed among the founding members of ASEAN and acceded to by all ASEAN members and 15 non-members.

name: Convention on Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims
summary: Admiralty law treaty regarding liability for maritime claims.

name: Budapest Treaty on the International Recognition of the Deposit of Microorganisms for the Purposes of Patent Procedure
summary: Adopted in 1977, the Budapest Treaty concerns a specific topic in the international patent process: microorganisms.

name: Torrijos–Carter Treaties
summary: Abrogates the Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty and guarantees Panama its eventual control of the Panama Canal after 1999.

name: Camp David Accords
summary: Agreement between Egypt and Israel.

name: Treaty of Peace and Friendship between Japan and the People's Republic of China
summary: Peace agreement between Japan and the People's Republic of China .

name: Egypt–Israel peace treaty
summary: Israel and Egypt agree to mutually recognize each other; Israel agrees to withdraw its troops from the Sinai Peninsula in return for Israeli ships to gain free passage through the Suez Canal .

name: Moon Treaty
note: Also known as the Agreement Governing the Activities of States on the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies or the Moon Agreement .
summary: Turns jurisdiction of all heavenly bodies to the international community; went into effect in 1984.

name: Treaty of Accession 1979
summary: The accession of Greece to the European Union.

name: Treaty of Montevideo
summary: Both Argentina and Chile pledge to a peaceful solution to their border disputes at the Beagle Channel .

name: Nairobi Treaty on the Protection of the Olympic Symbol
summary: All parties to the Nairobi Treaty are under the obligation to protect the Olympic symbol against commercial use (in advertisements, on goods, as a mark, etc.) without the authorization of the International Olympic Committee.

name: Australia New Zealand Closer Economic Relations Trade Agreement
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as ANZCERTA .
summary: A free trade agreement between the governments of New Zealand and Australia.

name: Sino-British Joint Declaration
note: Also known formally as the Joint Declaration of the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Question of Hong Kong .
summary: The United Kingdom relinquishes Hong Kong to the People's Republic of China.

name: Nkomati Accord
summary: Nonagression treaty between Mozambique and the Republic of South Africa .

name: Oujda Treaty
summary: Morocco and Libya establish the Arabic–African Union.

name: Treaty of Peace and Friendship of 1984 between Chile and Argentina
summary: Resolves disputes between Argentina and Chile over the possession of the Picton, Lennox and Nueva islands.

name: Plaza Accord
summary: The Group of Five agree to devalue the US dollar in relation to the Japanese yen and German Deutsche Mark by intervening in currency markets.

name: Schengen Agreement
summary: Establishes for the European Community a border system and a common policy on the temporary entry of persons.

name: 1985 Helsinki Protocol on the Reduction of Sulphur Emissions
note: Also known as the Protocol to the 1979 Convention on Long-Range Transboundary Air Pollution on the Reduction of Sulphur Emissions or Their Transboundary Fluxes by at Least 30% .
summary: Provides for a 30% reduction in sulphur emissions and their transboundary fluxes by 1993; came into effect in 1987.

name: Treaty of Rarotonga
note: Also known as the South Pacific Nuclear Free Zone Treaty .
summary: Formalizes a nuclear-weapon-free zone in the South Pacific.

name: China–Australia Migratory Bird Agreement
summary: Treaty between Australia and China to minimise harm to major areas used by birds that migrate between the two countries; came into force in 1988.

name: Convention on Early Notification of a Nuclear Accident
summary: In the wake of the Chernobyl disaster , states agree to promptly notify each other and the IAEA of nuclear accidents that occur.

name: Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty
summary: Eliminates nuclear and conventional ground-launched ballistic and cruise missiles with ranges of 500 to 5,500 kilometers (310 to 3,420 miles); ratified and came into force in 1988.

name: Joint Declaration on the Question of Macau
note: Also known formally as the Joint Declaration of the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Portugal on the question of Macao .
summary: Portugal relinquishes Macau to the People's Republic of China.

name: Nitrogen Oxide Protocol
note: Also known as the Protocol to the 1979 Convention on Long-Range Transboundary Air Pollution Concerning the Control of Emissions of Nitrogen Oxides or Their Transboundary Fluxes .
summary: Provides for the control or reduction of nitrogen oxides and their transboundary fluxes; came into effect in 1991.

name: United Nations Convention Against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances
summary: Enforcing the 1961 Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs and the 1971 Convention on Psychotropic Substances .

name: Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Maritime Navigation
summary: Criminalises hijacking and other dangerous acts on ships.

name: Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports serving International Civil Aviation
summary: Protocol to the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation , criminalises dangerous or violent acts in airports

name: Montreal Protocol
note: Also known as the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer .
summary: Attempts to protect the ozone layer by phasing out the production of a number of substances believed to be responsible for ozone depletion .

name: Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in Europe
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as the CFE .
summary: Establishes limits on key categories of conventional military equipment in Europe and mandates the destruction of excess weaponry.

name: Timor Gap Treaty
summary: Between the governments of Australia and Indonesia ; rewritten in 2001.

name: Wellington Convention
summary: Prohibits the use of fishing driftnets in the South Pacific that are longer than 2.5 metres.

name: Washington Treaty
summary: Adopted in Washington on May 26, 1989

name: Malaysia–Singapore Points of Agreement of 1990
summary: Treaty regarding the future of railway land owned by the Malaysian government through Malayan Railways in Singapore .

name: 1990 Chemical Weapons Accord
summary: On June 1, 1990, Presidents George H. W. Bush and Mikhail Gorbachev sign the bilateral U.S.-Soviet Chemical Weapons Accord.

name: Treaty on the Final Settlement with Respect to Germany
summary: The Four Powers renounce all rights they formerly held in Germany and Germany renounces all claims to territories east of the Oder–Neisse line .

name: Brioni Agreement
summary: Ends ten-day war in Slovenia .

name: Abuja Treaty
summary: International agreement that creates the African Economic Community .

name: Treaty of Asunción
summary: International treaty signed between Argentina , Brazil, Uruguay and Paraguay , served as the basis for the establishment of the Mercosur trade bloc.

name: Belavezha Accords
summary: Agreement which declared the Soviet Union effectively dissolved and established the Commonwealth of Independent States in its place.

name: Maastricht Treaty
note: Also known formally as the Treaty on European Union .
summary: Establishes the European Union .

name: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change
note: Also known, in its abbreviated forms, as the UNFCCC or the FCCC .
summary: Attempts to reduce emissions of greenhouse gasses in order to combat global warming .

name: Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)
summary: Conservation of biological diversity (or biodiversity), sustainable use of its components, and a fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising from genetic resources.

name: Treaty on Open Skies
summary: Establishes an international program of unarmed aerial surveillance flights over all participants' territories.

name: CIS Collective Security Treaty
summary: Armenia , Kazakhstan , Kyrgyzstan , Russia, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan establish framework for the Commonwealth of Independent States .

name: Sochi agreement
summary: Georgian and South Ossetian forces signed a ceasefire to halt the contemporaneously recognized "civil war."

name: Oslo I Accord
note: Also known as the Declaration of Principles on Interim Self-Government Arrangements or the Declaration of Principles (DOP).
summary: Between the Israeli government and the Palestine Liberation Organization.

name: Chemical Weapons Convention
note: Also known formally as the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and Use of Chemical Weapons and on their Destruction .
summary: Outlaws the production, stockpiling and use of chemical weapons .

name: Israel–Jordan peace treaty
note: Also known formally as the Treaty of Peace Between the State of Israel and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan .
summary: Normalizes relations between Israel and Jordan and resolves territorial disputes between them.

name: North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA)
summary: Free trade agreement between Canada, the United States of America, and Mexico.

name: Kremlin accords
summary: Stops the preprogrammed aiming of nuclear missiles at targets in any nation and provides for the dismantling of Russian nuclear weapons in Ukraine.

name: Bishkek Protocol
summary: Provisional ceasefire agreement between Armenia and Azerbaijan .

name: United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as the UNCLOS .
summary: Provides universal legal controls for the management of marine natural resources and the control of pollution .

name: United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification
note: Also known as the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification in Those Countries Experiencing Serious Drought and/or Desertification, Particularly in Africa .
summary: Agreement to combat desertification and to mitigate the effects of drought ; came into force in 1996.

name: Convention on Nuclear Safety
summary: States agree to general safety rules regarding civilian nuclear power plants and programmes.

name: Budapest Memorandum on Security Assurances
summary: Provides security guarantee to Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Belarus from US, UK and Russia.

name: Agreement on a Cease-fire and Separation of Forces
summary: Georgia and Abkhaz separatists sign a ceasefire agreement which provides for the deployment of UN-mandated CIS peacekeeping force to the conflict region.

name: Trademark Law Treaty
summary: Adopted in Geneva on October 27, 1994

name: Erdut Agreement
note: Also known as the Basic Agreement on the Region of Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium .
summary: Peaceful resolution of the conflict in Eastern Slavonia .

name: Dayton Agreement
note: Also known as the Dayton Accords , the Dayton-Paris Agreement and the General Framework Agreement for Peace in Bosnia and Herzegovina .
summary: Ends Bosnian War .

name: General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATT)
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as the GATS .
summary: Extends the multilateral trading system to provide services (i.e. tertiary sector of industry ).

name: Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as the CTBT .
summary: Forbids all nuclear explosions in all environments for military or civilian purposes.

name: Khasavyurt Accord
summary: Ceasefire agreement that ends the First Chechen War .

name: WIPO Copyright Treaty
note: Also known as the World Intellectual Property Organization Copyright Treaty .
summary: Provides additional protections for copyright deemed necessary due to advances in information technology.

name: WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as the WPPT .
summary: Establishes rights and privileges for performers and producers of audio-visual works.

name: Mahakali treaty
note: Also known as Sarada Treaty.
summary: Agreement between the Government of Nepal and the Government of India regarding the development of watershed of Mahakali River.

name: Amsterdam Treaty
note: Also known as the Treaty of Amsterdam amending the Treaty of the European Union, the Treaties establishing the European Communities and certain related acts .
summary: Substantially revises the Maastricht Treaty ; came into effect on May 1, 1999.

name: Ottawa Treaty
note: Also known as the Mine Ban Treaty and the Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti-Personnel Mines and on their Destruction .
summary: Bans all anti-personnel landmines (AP-mines).

name: Chemical Weapons Convention
note: Also known as the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and Use of Chemical Weapons and on their Destruction .
summary: Outlaws the production, stockpiling and use of chemical weapons .

name: Kyoto Protocol
note: Also known formally as the Kyoto Protocol to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change .
summary: Mandates the reduction of greenhouse-gas emissions ; negotiated in 1997, ratified in 2004, and went into effect in 2005.

name: Russian–Ukrainian Friendship Treaty
note: Also known formally as the Treaty on Friendship, Cooperation, and Partnership between Ukraine and the Russian Federation .
summary: Fixes the principle of strategic partnership, the recognition of the inviolability of existing borders, respect for territorial integrity and mutual commitment not to use its territory to harm the security of each other. Ratified in 1998 by Ukraine and in 1999 by Russia.

name: Russia–Chechnya Peace Treaty
summary: Russia and Chechen republic of Ichkeria sign a peace treaty following the First Chechen War , but the issue of independence remains unresolved and leads to the Second Chechen War .

name: Good Friday Agreement
note: Also known as the Belfast Agreement and rarely known as the Stormont Agreement .
summary: Major political development in the Northern Ireland peace process .

name: POP Air Pollution Protocol
note: Also known as the Protocol to the 1979 Convention on Long-Range Transboundary Air Pollution on Persistent Organic Pollutants .
summary: Agreement to provide for the control and reduction of emissions of persistent organic pollutants ; has not yet come into effect.

name: Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court
note: Also known as the Rome Statute .
summary: Establishes the International Criminal Court .

name: Adapted Conventional Armed Forces in Europe Treaty
summary: Replaces ceilings given to NATO and the Warsaw Pact with territorial ones.

name: East African Community Treaty
summary: Establishes the East African Community between Uganda , Kenya and the Republic of Tanzania ; went into effect on July 7, 2000.

name: Kumanovo Agreement
summary: Concluded the Kosovo War ; went into effect on June 9, 1999.

name: Narrative Protocol on Eastern and Western Sections of the China–Russia Boundary between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Russian Federation
summary: China's Jiang Zemin and Russia's president, Boris Yeltsin , signed in Beijing on Dec 9th, 1999. The treaty formally recognized 1.6 million square kilometers of land occupied by Russia belongs to Russia, and gave Russia the exit point of the Tumen River , cutting off northeast China from the Sea of Japan

name: Treaty Between the United States of America and Ukraine on Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters
summary: Establishes an agreement to provide mutual assistance in connection with the investigation, prosecution and prevention of offenses, and in proceedings related to criminal matters.

name: Cotonou Agreement
summary: Attempts to reduce poverty and integrate the ACP countries into the world economy; came into force in 2002.

name: Patent Law Treaty
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as the PLT .
summary: Harmonizes formal procedures such as the requirements to obtain a filing date for a patent application, the form and content of a patent application, and representation.

name: Treaty of Jeddah (2000)
summary: Resolves a border dispute between Saudi Arabia and Yemen that dates backs to Saudi boundary claims made in 1934.

name: Algiers Agreement (2000)
summary: A peace agreement between Eritrea and Ethiopia to formally end the Eritrean–Ethiopian War .

name: Agreement on the Conservation of Albatrosses and Petrels
summary: Attempts to prevent the decline of seabird populations in the southern hemisphere, particularly albatrosses and procellariidae .

name: Treaty of Nice
summary: Amends two founding treaties of the European Union .

name: Ohrid Agreement
summary: Ends the armed conflict between the Albanian National Liberation Army and Macedonia (now called North Macedonia).

name: 2001 Sino-Russian Treaty of Friendship
summary: Twenty-year strategic treaty between Russia and the People's Republic of China.

name: Budapest Convention on Cybercrime
summary: Prohibits the use of computers or networks as tools for criminal activity.

name: Timor Sea Treaty
summary: Between the governments of Australia and East Timor .

name: Strategic Offensive Reductions Treaty
note: Also known as the Moscow Treaty and SORT .
summary: Limits the nuclear arsenals of Russia and the United States.

name: Pretoria Accord
summary: Rwandan troops withdraw from the Democratic Republic of the Congo in exchange for international commitment towards the disarmament of the interahamwe and the ex-FAR fighters.

name: Gbadolite Agreement
summary: Attempts to cease hostilities between the warring factions in the Second Congo War ; treaty has limited effect.

name: ASEAN Agreement on Transboundary Haze Pollution
summary: Between ASEAN nations to bring haze pollution under control in Southeast Asia.

name: ASEAN Free Trade Area
note: Also known, in its abbreviated form, as AFTA .
summary: Agreement by the Association of Southeast Asian Nations , of local manufacturing in all ASEAN countries.

name: Treaty of Accession 2003
summary: Integrates ten nations into the European Union; came into force on May 1, 2004.

name: Accra Comprehensive Peace Agreement
summary: Ended the Second Liberian Civil War on August 18, 2003.

name: WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control
note: Also known, in abbreviated form, as FCTC .
summary: First public health treaty of the world; came into force on February 27, 2005. Its purpose is to "protect present and future generations from the devastating health, social, environmental and economic consequences of tobacco consumption and exposure to tobacco smoke."

name: International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture
note: Also known as the International Seed Treaty .
summary: Assures farmers' facilitated access to seeds of the world's food security crops; came into force on June 29, 2004.

name: Comprehensive Peace Agreement
note: Also known as the Naivasha Agreement .
summary: Ended the Second Sudanese Civil War between the Government of Sudan and the Sudan People's Liberation Army ; creates the Government of National Unity. Signed on January 9, 2005, and scheduled for full implementation by July 9, 2011.

name: Energy Community Treaty
summary: Establishes the Energy Community .

name: Treaty of Accession 2005
summary: Integrates two nations (Bulgaria and Romania) into the European Union; came into force on January 1, 2007.

name: Tripoli Agreement
note: Also known as the Libya Accord or the Tripoli Declaration .
summary: Ends Chadian–Sudanese conflict .GRATK Treaty milestones

name: Singapore Treaty on the Law of Trademarks
summary: Adopted in Singapore, on March 27, 2006

name: Waziristan Accord
note: Also known as the North Waziristan Accord .
summary: Ends Waziristan War .

name: St Andrews Agreement
summary: Resolves outstanding grievances in the Northern Ireland peace process, enabling devolved power-sharing government to resume.

name: Treaty of Lisbon
summary: Reforming the European Union .

name: ASEAN Charter
summary: New constitution making the Association of Southeast Asian Nations a legal entity.

name: UNASUR Constitutive Treaty
note: Constitutive Treaty of the Union of South American Nations Archived 2008-12-06 at the Wayback Machine Ministry of External Relations . Accessed on May 25, 2008.
summary: Treaty establishing the Union of South American Nations .

name: Barents Sea border treaty
summary: Treaty signed 15 September in Murmansk between the Government of the Russian Federation and the Government of the Kingdom of Norway. This treaty ends decades of negotiations over the maritime border in the Barents Sea.

name: Nagoya Protocol
summary: Implementation of one of the three objectives of the Convention on Biological Diversity (1992): fair and equitable sharing of benefits arising out of the utilization of genetic resources, thereby contributing to the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity.

name: Global Plan of Action to Combat Trafficking in Persons
summary: A human trafficking action plan adopted by the United Nations

name: Arctic Search and Rescue Agreement
summary: Treaty among the 8 member states of the Arctic Council signed 12 May 2011. It coordinates international search and rescue (SAR) coverage and response in the Arctic.

name: Treaty of Accession 2011
summary: Integrates Croatia into the European Union; came into force on July 1, 2013.

name: Framework Agreement on the Bangsamoro
summary: Treaty between the Philippine government and the Islamic liberation group, Moro Islamic Liberation Front . The treaty seeks to create a new autonomous political entity named Bangsamoro to replace the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao .

name: Beijing Treaty on Audiovisual Performances
summary: The Beijing Treaty on Audiovisual Performances was adopted on June 24, 2012, and entered into force on April 28, 2020. It deals with the intellectual property rights of performers in audiovisual performances.

name: Intergovernmental Agreement on Dry Ports
summary: Treaty among the members of the member states of the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific to facilitate cooperation in the development of a network of dry ports in Asia.

name: Marrakesh VIP Treaty
summary: Adopted on June 27, 2013 in Marrakesh . It forms part of the body of international copyright treaties administered by World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO).

name: Convention on the Manipulation of Sports Competitions
summary: Council of Europe treaty to combat match fixing in sports

name: Treaty on the Accession of Crimea to Russia
summary: Treaty signed between Russia and the self-declared independent Republic of Crimea which is only recognised by a small number of countries

name: Paris Agreement
summary: Agreement dealing with greenhouse-gas emissions mitigation

name: Geneva Act of the Lisbon Agreement on Appellations of Origin and Geographical Indications
summary: Treaty extending protections of the Lisbon Agreement (1958) to Geographical Indications

name: Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons
summary: The first legally binding international agreement to comprehensively prohibit nuclear weapons , with the goal of leading towards their total elimination.

name: Prespa agreement
summary: The final agreement between Greece and the then- Republic of Macedonia for the name of the second.

name: Treaty of Aachen (2019)
summary: Bilateral treaty between France and Germany for regional issues; including, military, cultural, and political issues. With special attention being given to defense politics.

name: United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement
summary: Trilateral free trade agreement which replaced NAFTA (1994).

name: 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement
summary: The armistice agreement that ended the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War .

name: Darfur Peace Agreement
summary: An agreement signed by the Government of Sudan and Darfur-based rebel groups with the intention of ending the Darfur Conflict .

name: Agreement for Bringing Peace to Afghanistan
summary: The Agreement for Bringing Peace to Afghanistan, commonly known as the United States–Taliban deal or the Doha Accord, was a peace agreement signed by the United States and the Taliban on 29 February 2020 in Doha , Qatar , to bring an end to the 2001–2021 war in Afghanistan .

name: Armenia–EU Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement (CEPA)
summary: An agreement governing the bilateral relations between Armenia and the EU .

name: Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement
summary: A peace treaty that ended the Tigray War .

name: Treaty of Jeddah (2023)
summary: The agreement was intended to facilitate a week-long ceasefire in the 2023 Sudan conflict but expired two days after the signing due to a sudden surge in hostilities.

name: Riyadh Design Law Treaty
summary: The Riyadh Design Law Treaty (RDLT) was adopted on November 22, 2024, and will enter into force three months after there have been 15 ratifications or accessions.

name: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
note: Also known as GRATK Treaty milestones.
summary: Adopted in Geneva - May 24, 2024
